info.text:
China's economy sped up. Its own shoppers barely did.
China's GDP grew 4.5% in Q3 2026, beating the 4.4% forecast and up from 4.3% in Q2.
Exports jumped 36.3% in September, but retail sales rose just 1.1%.
Real estate investment fell 20.6% in January-September, and the trade surplus hit $938 billion.
Sources: China National Bureau of Statistics and customs data, via Reuters and AP (Oct 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
